transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I'm here because... well, I keep thinking it would just be better if I didn't wake up. And honestly, sometimes I feel like dying would be the fair punishment for what I've done to my family and my crew.
Have you had any specific thoughts about how you might end your life, or have you made any plans or taken any steps toward ending your life?

No, I haven't made any actual plans or taken any steps. Like I just mentioned, it's more that I just keep hoping I won't wake up. I haven't sat down and figured out a specific way to do it... it's just this constant thought in my head that dying is what I deserve. That it would be a fair punishment for what I've done to my family and the guys on my crew. But no, I don't have a plan.
When did these feelings of wanting not to wake up and deserving punishment start? Have they been going on for at least two weeks, or have they come and gone over a longer period of time?

It's been a lot longer than two weeks. Um, I'd say this has been going on for about a year and two months now. It started a few months after my husband's injury... and it just hasn't really stopped since.
Have there been any periods of time during the past year when you felt even slightly better or had some relief from these thoughts, or have they been pretty much constant throughout?

Well, they've been pretty constant. For most of the time since this started, the guilt... the exhaustion... just not having any interest in things, and those thoughts about death, they've all just been there. I mean, some weeks might be a little less crushing than others, but... no, I wouldn't say I've had any real relief. It's pretty much always there.
Have there been times when you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or so good that you didn't feel like you needed much sleep, or maybe even felt like you could take on the world?

No, I haven't ever felt like that. I've pretty much just been exhausted and down this whole time. I definitely haven't had any bursts of energy or felt like I could take on the world... honestly, just getting through the day takes everything I have. So no, nothing like that.
Have you had similar feelings of depression, guilt, or loss of interest in things for at least two years, or is this the first time you've felt this way for such an extended period?

No, this is the first time. I've never felt anything like this before... definitely not for two years. It really just started that year and two months ago, like I said. Before that, I was fine. I mean, life had its normal ups and downs, but nothing like this constant heavy feeling.
Can you describe your mood during the day—does it feel like you're depressed most of the time, or does it fluctuate significantly?

It's most of the time. I'd say I feel depressed pretty much all day, every day. It doesn't really fluctuate or get better... it's just this heavy, low feeling from the time I wake up until I go to sleep.

Before this current period of feeling down and exhausted, have you ever had a time when you felt unusually good, unusually energetic, or maybe even impulsive enough to do things that others might consider out of character for you?

No, I've never had anything like that. Like I said before, I haven't had any bursts of energy or felt unusually good. Before all this started, I was just... normal. I went to work, laid carpet, came home. I wasn't impulsive or doing anything out of character. I just felt like myself.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over the past year, like eating much less than usual or losing weight without trying?

Yeah, actually. Most days I just forget to eat until it's really late in the day. Or if I do try to have something, I'll take a few bites and just feel sick. I definitely haven't been trying to lose weight, but my work pants have gotten pretty loose on me lately.
Have you felt like you are a failure, or that you have let others down in a significant way, especially related to your family or crew?

Yeah, I do. All the time. I keep thinking... I'm the reason my husband got worse. And the crew, we lost work because of me. I just feel like I messed up clients' homes, you know? It's like I poisoned everything I touched. I really feel like I deserve whatever happens to me because of it all.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, or found that you don’t take pleasure in things the way you used to?

Yeah, I have. I don't really do much of anything anymore. I used to paint, and I liked cooking big meals for everyone. I'd even go for a run before starting a job, and I was involved in local theater, showing up for rehearsals and all that. But now... I just don't care. Thinking about doing any of that just feels like a chore, like it's from somebody else's life. I don't care if I miss any of it now.
Have you noticed that your thoughts feel slowed down, or that you're moving more slowly than usual, or maybe even restless and unable to sit still?
No, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed feeling slowed down or anything like that. And I'm not restless either. I just sit there, mostly.
Have you felt worthless or guilty nearly every day during this period?

Yes, every single day. I know I already said this, but... I just can't stop thinking that I'm the reason my husband got worse. And I caused the crew to lose work. I feel like I messed up those clients' homes. It's just this constant feeling that I poisoned everything I touched, and... I really do feel like I deserve whatever bad things happen to me because of it.
